doctrine: Keys replay SELECTION, never authorization. Money/irreversible steps re-resolve their gate at replay time.

1.name: GO
1.acts: Drain all ready A-tasks, measured, receipted. H-tasks surface on block.
1.close: drained {n_ready} ready, {n_receipts} receipts, {n_blocked} blocked on you

3.name: DIG
3.acts: Review-until-obvious on the current blocker (bounded at 3, then H).

4.name: PICK
4.acts: Choose option N on the open choice task.

5.name: OK
5.acts: Approve the surfaced H-task. Money opens keyword capture; gate re-resolves.

6.name: NO
6.acts: Deny the surfaced H-task; replan around it.

7.name: TELL
7.acts: Answer the open input task. Key-shaped input refused.

9.name: FIX
9.acts: File a correction (bare = auto-context + replan; +text = directed). Feeds learn.

0.name: STOP
0.acts: Halt (writes HALT.json) or resume (lifts it). Read-only keys 2,3 still work under halt.

grammar: Digits are verbs. Only 4 and 8 consume a following digit. 7, money-5 and directed-9 open text capture. Anything else is a ValueError, never a guess.
never_autonomous: Any M-path, money-5 with amount, key-shaped TELL payloads. Hard exclusion, not a threshold.
